newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi looks forward to expanding ties with Britain.
newsitem.headline: Saudi looks forward to expanding ties with Britain.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd has said the kingdom looked forward to expanding its relations with Britain and voiced satisfaction with the results of a visit to London by Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan.
The official Saudi Press Agency said King Fahd made his comments at a weekly cabinet meeting in Riyadh on Monday night.

It said the king praised the "increasing improvement" in relations between the two countries and said Saudi Arabia "looked forward to expanding the scope of constructive and balanced cooperation" between Saudi and Britain.

Britain is one of Saudi Arabia's main trading partners, but relations had suffered tensions, augmented by veiled Saudi threats last year that London might lose billions of dollars worth of export business because of bitter criticism of the Saudi royal family by London-based dissident Mohammad al-Masari.
Both Saudi and British officials said during Prince Sultan's visit to London last week that relations were excellent and that the Masari issue was not discussed.
